```yaml
name: Auto-approve workflows for first-time contributors

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Get PR information
        id: pr_info
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=contributor::$(git log --format='%aN <%ae>' ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | head -n 1)"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_count::$(git log --author="$(git log --format='%aN <%ae>' ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | head -n 1)" --pretty=count)"

      - name: Check if contributor is first-time
        id: check_contributor
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.pr_info.outputs.pr_count }}" -le 1 ]]; then
            echo "Contributor is first-time"
            echo "::set-output name=is_first_time::true"
          else
            echo "Contributor is not first-time"
            echo "::set-output name=is_first_time::false"
          fi

      - name: Approve workflows if contributor is returning or has ok-to-test label
        if: github.event.label.name == 'ok-to-test' || steps.check_contributor.outputs.is_first_time == 'true'
        run: |
          gh pr review ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --approve
```

    types: [labeled, synchronize]

      - main
      - 'release-*'

  contents: read
  actions: write

  auto-approve:

          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Get PR information
        id: pr_info
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=contributor::$(git log --format='%aN <%ae>' ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | head -n 1)"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_count::$(git log --author="$(git log --format='%aN <%ae>' ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | head -n 1)" --pretty=count)"

      - name: Check if contributor is first-time
        id: check_contributor
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.pr_info.outputs.pr_count }}" -le 1 ]]; then

            echo "::set-output name=is_first_time::true"
          else
            echo "Contributor is not first-time"
            echo "::set-output name=is_first_time::false"
